column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle trials` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition
# in spec/Aontu: documents with trial schemas inside values, each case its
# declarations and a map as the schema against a map as the document, run in
# the default mode, without the fill (noFill) and under --partial (partial),
# as `verdict` rows whose expectation is the one class `vet` gives, which
# `vet_iff` makes the definition's own. nof(n, ...) counts the branches that
# admit the value and judges as n judges the count; must(c, m) asks what
# nof(1, c) asks; when(c, t, e) holds the value to the branch c picks, an e
# not written passing; contains(c, n) counts the members c admits and judges
# as n judges the count, at least one where n is not written, a scalar having
# none; rest(t, c, ...) holds each member no cover c evaluates to t, a cover
# applying where its if admits the whole and evaluating the members its keys
# or members admits; match(s, p, r, ...) is the first r whose p admits the value
# of s, else its default, and an error with none, and filter(s, c) is the members
# of the value of s that c admits, each made once the document is read; a
# branch that admits nothing counts as none; a container
# a trial refuses once its members have all arrived is invalid; and a name that
# refers to itself through a trial alone breaks the alias-cycle rule, an
# error. Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The cases the ports
# do not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
# A spread that selects on key(0), the key of the member it is tried on, or
# the position of the item, follows in rows y0 on, contains over a recursive
# name, which the meet reads as its body, in rows tc0 on, and a trial with a
# dead argument both ports read as they build it in rows te0 on.
